cassandra_rule: SizeTieredCompactionStrategy.getNextBackgroundTask: fewer than min_threshold (4) candidates yields no compaction task.
getBuckets: equal-size SSTables land in one bucket; a bucket with >= min_threshold members is selected in full (<= max_threshold).

getBuckets with bucket_low=0.5/bucket_high=1.5: only files within [0.5,1.5]x the running bucket average join a bucket; the 60MB and 500MB outliers fall outside the ~100MB bucket and are excluded, leaving the four 100MB files as the sole eligible bucket.

getBuckets: each size is > 1.5x its smaller neighbor so every file forms its own singleton bucket (all >= min_sstable_size=50MB, so the small-file bypass never applies); no bucket reaches min_threshold and no compaction is selected.
getBuckets: SSTables below min_sstable_size (50MB) are grouped together regardless of the size ratio; the four sub-50MB files form one bucket meeting min_threshold and are selected.
getBuckets: the four sub-50MB files group via the small-file bypass while the 100MB file (>= min_sstable_size) stays in its own bucket; only the small cluster reaches min_threshold and is selected.
